content:
### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 to 1024, 45):** App icon + Title (Left), Utility Icons (Right), Window Controls (Far Right).
*   **Sidebar (0, 45 to 280, 950):** Vertical navigation list.
    *   *Data Recovery Section:* Header at top. Items: Hardware Disk (Selected), SD Card, More Recovery Tools.
    *   *Advanced Features Section:* Header. Items: File Repair, Lost Partition Rescue.
    *   *File Backup Section:* Header. Item: ChronoSnap Backup.
*   **Main Content Area (280, 45 to 1024, 950):**
    *   *Header:* "Select a location..." heading with help icon.
    *   *Sub-header:* "Internal drives (2)" label with underline.
    *   *Info Banner:* "Unable to find your hard drive?" dismissible banner.
    *   *Device Grid:* 2-column grid of drive cards (Virtual_Disk, Microsoft NVMe) on the left; List of detected partitions (Recovery, Windows(C:), Temp(D:)) on the right.
    *   *Footer:* "Continue" link (bottom left), "Got it" button (bottom right).
*   **Overlay / Modal (Centered):** "Solution 3" popup dialog obscuring the center of the main area.

### 2. TEXT
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar Headers:** `Data Recovery`, `Advanced Features`, `File Backup`
*   **Sidebar Items:** `Hardware Disk`, `SD Card`, `More Recovery Tools`, `File Repair`, `Lost Partition Rescue`, `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Heading:** `Select a location to search for lost data`
*   **Sub-heading:** `Internal drives (2)`
*   **Banner Text:** `Unable to find your hard drive?`
*   **Modal Title:** `Solution 3:`
*   **Modal Body:** `Reconnect your drive and try again.`
*   **Modal Footer:** `3/3` (Badge), `Got it` (Button)
*   **Device Tile 1:** `Virtual_Disk NVME Pre...`, `150 GB`, `Search Entire Disk`
*   **Device Tile 2:** `Microsoft NVMe Direct ...`, `220 GB`, `Search Entire Disk`
*   **Partition List Items:** `Recovery`, `450 MB`; `Windows(C:)`, `28.28 GB/149.45 GB`; `Temp(D:)`, `219.98 GB/219.98 GB`
*   **Main Footer:** `Continue`, `Got it`
*   **Button (Right Overlay):** `Device Detection`

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window BG: `#E8EBF0` (Light Blue-Grey) - ESTIMATED
    *   Sidebar BG: `#F0F2F5` (Slightly lighter grey) - ESTIMATED
    *   Main Panel BG: `#FFFFFF` (White) - ESTIMATED
    *   Selected Sidebar Item: `#D6E4FF` (Light Blue) - ESTIMATED
    *   Modal BG: `#1890FF` (Vibrant Blue) - ESTIMATED
    *   Banner BG: `#F5F5F5` (Light Grey) - ESTIMATED
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text: `#1F1F1F` (Near Black) - ESTIMATED
    *   Secondary Text: `#666666` or `#888888` (Dark Grey) - ESTIMATED
    *   Modal Text: `#FFFFFF` (White) - ESTIMATED
    *   Selected Sidebar Text: `#1890FF` (Blue) - ESTIMATED
*   **Accents & Borders:**
    *   Primary Button BG: `#1890FF` - ESTIMATED
    *   Progress Bars: Yellow (`#FAAD14`), Blue (`#1890FF`) - ESTIMATED
    *   Borders: `#E0E0E0` (Light Grey dividers) - ESTIMATED

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** ~11px, Regular (Segoe UI/System font).
*   **Sidebar Headers:** ~11px, Bold/Grey.
*   **Sidebar Items:** ~13px, Regular.
*   **Main Heading:** ~20px, Semi-bold.
*   **Sub-heading:** ~13px, Regular/Grey.
*   **Modal Title:** ~16px, Bold.
*   **Modal Body:** ~14px, Regular.
*   **Device Names:** ~14px, Bold.
*   **Stats/Capacity:** ~12px, Regular/Grey.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Sidebar Item Height:** ~44px.
*   **Sidebar Icon Size:** 24x24px.
*   **Modal Dimensions:** ~360px width x ~220px height.
*   **Modal Padding:** ~24px.
*   **Modal Radius:** ~8px.
*   **Button Heights:** ~36px (Standard), ~32px (Small/Got it).
*   **Device Tiles:** Width ~340px, Padding ~16px.
*   **Gutters:** ~16px between grid items.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar Item (Hardware Disk):** State = **Selected** (Blue background, blue text, green checkmark badge).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   `Search Entire Disk`: State = **Normal** (Primary Blue fill, white text).
    *   `Got it` (Modal): State = **Normal** (White fill, blue text).
    *   `Got it` (Main): State = **Normal** (Primary Blue fill).
    *   `Continue`: State = **Link/Text**.
*   **Progress Bars:** Visual indicators of capacity usage (Partial fill).
*   **Close Buttons (X):** Present on Modal and Info Banner.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline/Filled hybrid (mostly filled for sidebar, outline for utility).
*   **Grid:** 24x24px standard.
*   **Specifics:**
    *   Sidebar: Hard Drive (Blue filled), SD Card (Grey), Tools (Grey), Folder (Grey), Globe (Grey), Clock (Grey).
    *   Modal: Character illustration (Cartoon style, white/blue).
    *   Main Area: Question mark circle, Close (X).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Partial/Interactive Overlay**. The underlying page is the "Select Location" step of a recovery wizard. A contextual "Solution" modal is currently open, blocking interaction with the main drive selection interface.
*   **Visual Cues:** The background is dimmed (overlay effect). The modal is the active focus element.
